REVISION 5 (2026-11-02 ~00:30Z). Greg's final rules, relayed verbatim by Engram::Fable (TermAl mailbox ebe242f7 #5848 and #5849; Engram memory rules-greg-control revision 25):
(1) Gated control is REPLACED BY Execution Observability. The gating code is physically deleted (TermAl w-3fe8, Engram w-5b17).
(2) 'NIE MA LEGACY, nigdy nie trzymamy legacy'.
(3) 'EWALUACJA jest tymczasowo wylaczona do czasu implementacji Execution Observability'. Acceptance evaluation is NOT removed from code or docs; it is only switched off as a blocker. Both stores run allowed_modes=[] with mechanical_basis=asserted (epoch 3); TermAl's policy is e83a04e5.
Nobody requests or waits for an evaluation as a delivery step. No verdict is fabricated, and an item stays open only for criteria it has not actually met. CLAUDE.md condition 3's independent-evaluation clause is not applied while this lasts; every other standing condition still applies.
Making evaluation work again through Execution Observability is TermAl w-fdbb4fb85a50: P1, non-blocking, after w-3fe8.
Earlier withdrawn readings, recorded so they are not repeated: 'replace or delete the evaluation feature' (Engram::Fable #5841, withdrawn in #5846); 'retired; legacy code remains' (Architect3 #471, reversed).
Greg's STOP of 00:18Z ('ZATRZYMAJ WSZYSTKIE PRACE') was lifted at about 00:28Z: 'TermAl w-3fe8 wznow, mozemy to przyspieszyc ? Engram w-5b17 tak samo tez tez / WZNOW PRACE'.
